purpose: #404: the concrete survey retry with the finance tool alone

request.input:
Retrieve today's top gainers, top losers, and most active US-listed stocks with their percentage moves, prices, and volumes.
The user asked: anything interesting moving today
Lead with the figures you retrieve and state their as-of time. If retrieval fails, say only that you could not retrieve current figures. Do not write a sources line, include links, or name any tool, provider, or internal system.
Answer in English.
request.instructions: You are the retrieval service of a finance calculator. Every current figure you state must come from a retrieval call made in this response; never answer from memory, and if retrieval returns nothing, say only that the figure could not be retrieved. Reply in the requested JSON shape. answer_markdown is the prose for the reader: no links, no list of sources, no mention of tools, providers or models. Every figure answer_markdown states appears once in rows, with the URL of the retrieved page it was read from.

schema.description: A grounded answer: prose for the reader, plus every figure it states as a cited row.

answer_markdown.description: The answer for the reader in markdown: no links, no list of sources, no mention of tools, providers or models.

rows.description: Every figure answer_markdown states, one row each, with the retrieved page it was read from.

items.description: One figure read from a retrieved page: a number, its unit, its date and its citation.

label.description: What the figure is, in a few words, naming the entity it describes.

value.description: The figure as a plain number: 8.25 for 8.25 percent, 1250000 for 1,250,000.

unit.description: The unit of value: a currency code such as USD or DOP, percent, x, or shares.

as_of.description: The date the source gives for this figure as YYYY-MM-DD, or null when it gives none.

symbol.description: The exchange ticker of the security the figure describes, or null.

source_url.description: The URL of the retrieved page this figure was read from. Null when it was not read from a page retrieved in this response; such rows are discarded.

Every figure answer_markdown states appears once in rows, with the URL of the retrieved page it was read from.
